units.rawText: An intense battle breaks out inside the gallery.
units.displayText: An intense battle breaks out inside the gallery.

spans.text: An intense battle breaks out inside the gallery.

units.rawText: Riko stands in a daze outside the door, listening to the sounds from inside.
units.displayText: Riko stands in a daze outside the door, listening to the sounds from inside.

spans.text: Riko stands in a daze outside the door, listening to the sounds from inside.

units.rawText: Professor, be careful! Please stay behind me and support us!
units.displayText: Professor, be careful! Please stay behind me and support us!

spans.text: Professor, be careful! Please stay behind me and support us!

units.rawText: Sol, don't rush so far ahead!
units.displayText: Sol, don't rush so far ahead!

spans.text: Sol, don't rush so far ahead!

units.rawText: I need to keep you guys safe. Relax, this is nothing–
units.displayText: I need to keep you guys safe. Relax, this is nothing–

spans.text: I need to keep you guys safe. Relax, this is nothing–

units.rawText: The familiar voice awakens her memories, and her thoughts drift to a faraway place.
units.displayText: The familiar voice awakens her memories, and her thoughts drift to a faraway place.
